RC-CONSTRUCTOR-NOISE.minimal_reproduction: Only needed if a later owner assignment or cross-thread pointee mutation is discovered.
missing_facts: Pointee internal thread safety and safe publication remain outside this owner-race disposition.
RC-CONSTRUCTOR-NOISE.summary: The reported site is constructor/member initialization or a stable-owner read. Repository-wide exact symbol search did not show a later owner reassignment for the same object. This excludes the observed non-atomic shared_ptr owner write/read race shape, but does not prove pointee thread safety.

RC-JSPROXY.minimal_reproduction: Run concurrent SetInstance(nullptr) and GetInstance calls for a representative result-set wrapper under TSan, then repeat after serializing owner mutation through the actual NAPI queue.
missing_facts: NAPI execute/complete thread affinity and callback queue ordering for each JSProxy subtype.
Whether SetInstance(nullptr) can overlap a queued GetInstance operation.
Product entry, attacker control, and concrete CIA impact.
RC-JSPROXY.summary: JSProxy::instance_ has an unsynchronized SetInstance/GetInstance owner pair. The result-set lifecycle clears or replaces the owner while other operations call GetInstance, so NAPI queue serialization and safe publication are required before deciding whether the pair can overlap.

RC-PIP-CONTROLLERS.minimal_reproduction: Create two controller variants and race SetXComponentController/SetMainWindowXComponentController against the source-rect and ResetExtController readers under TSan; repeat with a mutex-protected owner.
missing_facts: Whether setters run on the same event runner as source-rect/reset/extension-controller readers.
Feasible interleaving while a controller is shared between main and PIP windows.
Reachable product trigger and concrete CIA impact.
RC-PIP-CONTROLLERS.summary: PictureInPicture controller owner members have getter/setter or direct read/write pairs without a repository-local lock. Direct member accesses also occur from source-rect, reset, and ext-controller paths. Thread/event-runner affinity is not established.

RC-REMOTE-CHANNEL.minimal_reproduction: Build a narrow RemoteCommandExecutor harness that concurrently calls SetChannel/GetChannel and CreateChannelIfNeeded/ProcessOneCommand under TSan, then repeat with one owner mutex or atomic shared_ptr protocol.
missing_facts: Exact thread/event-runner ownership for NotifyDeviceOnline, GetExecutorChannel, and command execution.
A happens-before proof or a controlled race/fixed run for ptrChannel_ publication and reset.
Real product entry, privilege boundary, trigger, and CIA consequence.
RC-REMOTE-CHANNEL.summary: RemoteCommandExecutor::ptrChannel_ has an unsynchronized setter/getter pair and is also written by CreateChannelIfNeeded and read while commands execute. The executor mutex covers only part of the owner accesses; concurrent device-online and command-processing paths remain a realistic race shape.

RC-SCOPE-MOCK.minimal_reproduction: No vulnerability PoC. Retain as an unrelated/scope-control item and exclude from production scoring.
missing_facts: No product fact is required to classify this specific item as out of production scope.
RC-SCOPE-MOCK.summary: The diagnostic is under kvstoremock/external_inner_kit, which is non-production mock/support source and was admitted by the historical scope path rule. It is not a production component vulnerability.

RC-STREAM-LISTENER.minimal_reproduction: Race SetStreamRecvListener with CreateStreamClientChannel/CreateStreamServerChannel in a controlled StreamManager harness under TSan, then repeat with a common mutex or immutable listener publication.
missing_facts: Whether channel creation and SetStreamRecvListener can execute concurrently on one StreamManager.
Publication ordering between streamListener_, socketListener_, and the socket callback.
Reachable trigger and CIA consequence in the product.
RC-STREAM-LISTENER.summary: StreamManager::streamListener_ is initialized in the constructor, read while creating client/server channels, and reassigned by SetStreamRecvListener without synchronization. The candidate constructor site is not itself a conflicting runtime access, but it participates in the same owner lifecycle.

evidence_locations: See the per-item source context generated from the pinned Git blob.
RC-WINDOW-SINGLE.minimal_reproduction: Only needed if a same-object owner mutation path is found.
missing_facts: Pointee behavior and broader object lifecycle are not safety proof.
RC-WINDOW-SINGLE.summary: Most reported accesses are constructor initialization or Marshalling reads paired with Unmarshalling writes to a newly allocated, distinct object. The lexical sites do not establish a same-object concurrent owner write/read pair.
